title: critical-areas.json
description: The high-risk areas canary-critical-areas writes to .canary/critical-areas.json and canary-katana alarms on. Not a canary.* layer: the file carries no contract field. Unknown fields are tolerated. Rules the subset cannot express (a non-empty symbols list, a minimum symbol length) live in critical-areas.mjs.

risk_score.$comment: A number >= 0. A numeric string and null are accepted for back-compat: katana always read risk_score with parseFloat (null reads as 0).

symbols.$comment: Optional (#1242). The names a test title must contain to count as covering this area, matched case-insensitively on letters and digits. Replaces the path basename, which is too generic to match on for areas like engine.ts or rules.ts.
